FN-98EJMBM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 157
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/27/2024
Senate Bill 157 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Education and the local boards of education to adopt rules pursuant to the provisions of this
bill. Additionally, this bill could increase the financial obligations of local boards of education
to reimburse officers and employees that have successfully defended themselves in a civil or
criminal legal action when they were conducting themselves in accordance with their assigned
duties and responsibilities. This bill would also require an employee found or pleaded guilty, to
reimburse the local board of education for any legal services expenses incurred by the local
board.

FN-98EJMBM-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 157
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 157 as passed the Senate would increase the administrative obligations of the State
Board of Education and the local boards of education to adopt rules regarding student discipline
pursuant to the provisions of this bill. Additionally, this bill could increase the obligations of the
Educator's Liability Trust Fund and/or local boards of education by an undetermined amount
dependent on the cost to reimburse officers and employees in certain legal actions.
Further, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Division of Risk
Management to provide an annual report to the Legislature detailing expenditures made during
the preceding year pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
